primary: Grouped agreement, per-class recall, confusion and probability loss; source-grounded full analysis reviewed separately
class_limit: Only one REFUTED group. No statistical/generalization claim.
review: One post-training concentrated review of decisive evidence, opposition, gaps, binding and polarity; includes shared errors and omitted sources
binding_limit: One focal-request test judgment with concrete binding records. Multiple competing bindings without separate reference status remain disputed/unknown; no invented per-binding labels.
stop: 36 fits maximum; 17 baseline tasks once each; no retries/tuning/semantic fixes after freeze
